### Describe the bug
A clear description of what went wrong.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Launch `winscroller-alt-tab.exe` (specify any flags like `--no-elevate`, `--demo`, etc.)
2. Press `Alt+Tab` / drag window / click `+ New desktop`...
3. Observed result vs expected result.

### Environment
- **Windows Version & Build:** (e.g. Windows 11 24H2 Build 26100)
- **Elevated (Administrator):** Yes / No (`--no-elevate`)
- **Monitor setup / DPI scaling:** (e.g. Single 1920x1080 @ 100%, Dual @ 150%)
- **Winscroller Alt+Tab Version / Commit:** (e.g. `v0.1.0`)
